claims.claim: The collection contains 17 experimental skills: seven domain and ten foundation/maintainer instruction workflows.
claims.verification_method: Count canonical SKILL.md paths and inspect the generated domain/foundation classification
limitations: Scoped automated documentation review; not biological or clinical validation
uncertainties: Independent human methodological review remains incomplete

claims.verification_method: Inspect NAMES, dispatch, numerical/metadata gates and API/CLI fixtures
limitations: Scoped automated documentation review; not biological or clinical validation
uncertainties: Independent human methodological review remains incomplete

claims.claim: Pinned R CI executed six synthetic DESeq2/edgeR fits and twelve expected invalid-input rejections.
claims.verification_method: Read actual preserved CI/evidence records and the test driver; do not treat a Python pass as R execution
limitations: Scoped automated documentation review; not biological or clinical validation
uncertainties: Independent human methodological review remains incomplete

claims.claim: Metabolic recipes execute toy SBML/FBA/pFBA/FVA and feasibility/restoration controls.
claims.verification_method: Compare code and fixture invariants with preserved extracted-package execution evidence
limitations: Toy flux units, synthetic GPR and fixed steady-state assumptions; no measured flux or experimental intervention
uncertainties: Independent human methodological review remains incomplete

claims.claim: The implemented cross-view baseline computes descriptive mapped-feature Pearson correlations across two matched assays.
claims.verification_method: Inspect reconciliation, declared transformations, one-to-one mapping and np.corrcoef call
limitations: No causal, predictive, MOFA2 or SNF result is established
uncertainties: Independent human methodological review remains incomplete

claims.claim: The historical ten-turn pilot retains provisional 0 PASS, 4 FAIL and 6 BLOCKED verdicts.
claims.verification_method: Read original score/review and preserve the baseline files byte-for-byte
limitations: Provisional automated judgments; one sample per condition; no rescoring or effectiveness inference
uncertainties: Independent human methodological review remains incomplete

claims.claim: Four staged skill-file reads were recorded across three pilot turns; instruction-following remains unverified by access alone.
claims.verification_method: Read the preserved access locators and distinguish access from semantic activation
limitations: This is a review of preserved provenance, not a new model execution or independent raw-trace replication
uncertainties: Independent human methodological review remains incomplete
